id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

effectTriggers.description:
Collection of extra async {@link UiSdlEffectTrigger}.

Effect triggers are registered globally. They are registered dynamically at runtime when the component instance
they are defined on is being loaded. All registered observers subscribing to the same action will be notified when the
action is dispatched regardless of which page defined the trigger.

componentRef.description:
A component ref pointing to a non-connected component to be rendered.
Useful when you want to reuse component metadata but want to use different ids.

component.description:
Inline component definition. This is useful when you don't want to reuse
the rendered component somewhere else or if you want to override configuration of
the referenced component in `componentRef`.

applicationStateRef.description: A reference to a `UiSdlApplicationState` to be initialized by the component

title:
Connected UI components get their configurations from a state management store.

The rendered component will behave as a singleton, when rendered
